coordinator_message: Coordinator: source watch saw you introduced value.unwrap().as_bytes() in new emergency_deny_state. Unwrap is forbidden. Use let Some(value) = ... else { return Ok(Inactive) }; then borrow checked bytes with actual Slice API. No new unwrap/expect/indexing/allow. All original assertions must remain except precise namespace count/list changes; do not use cargo fmt --all to leave broad unrelated edits without reporting. Public activate must not overwrite malformed/unsupported markers and must return storage failure if SyncAll fails.
